title: A Map in the Rain
story: Amina and Ben were visiting an old town for the first time. They left the hotel with a paper map folded in Amina's coat. After ten minutes a hard rain began, and the streets shone. They stood under a shop awning and opened the map. A drop landed on the paper and made a pale mark near the river. Ben wanted to find the museum before lunch. Amina turned the map the right way and pointed to a bridge. She said they were on the north side and the museum was on the south side. They needed to cross the river and then turn left. The wind pulled at the map, so Ben held one corner while Amina held the other. They agreed to walk fast and to keep the map inside the coat between streets. At the bridge they checked the map once more under a stone arch. The mark from the rain had not covered the road they needed. They crossed, turned left, and saw a sign for the museum at the end of the lane. Inside the entrance it was warm and dry. Ben said the map had done its job even with a wet spot. Before they left, Amina folded the map carefully and put it in a plastic sleeve from the ticket desk. The next walk would be easier if the paper stayed whole.
